newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Evergreen School District, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Evergreen School District, Calif..

text.p: CORRECTED NOTICE OF INTENTION TO SELL BONDS
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Evergreen School District (the District''), in Santa Clara County, California, intends to offer for public sale on

(which date is different from and supplants the June 12, 1997 date of sale as originally provided in the Notice of Intention to Sell Bonds published in this publication on May 27, 1997) at the hour of 10:00 a.m., California time, at the office of Brown & Wood LLP, 555 California Street, 50th Floor, San Francisco, California 94104 $10,000,000*

principal amount of general obligation bonds of the District designated Evergreen School District, County of Santa Clara, California 1997 General Obligation Bonds (Election of 1989), Series D'' (the ithin 26 hours, the Santa Clara County Director of Finance, or his designee, in conjunction with the Superintendent of the District, will consider the bids for the Bonds and, if an acceptable bid or bids are received, award the sale of the Bonds. In the event that no bid is awarded by the designated time for the Bonds, proposals will be received the following Monday at the same time and place specified above and each Monday thereafter until such time as a bid is awarded for each of the Bonds or notice to the contrary is given. NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Bonds, dated July 1, 1997, will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale. An Official Statement and Official Notice of Sale will be furnished upon request to Kelling, Northcross & Nobriga, Inc., 1333 Broadway, Suite 1000, Oakland, California 94612, (510) 839-8200, the financial advisor to the District for the Bonds.
